items.title: E Kaabo! Ibarapa Land Welcomes Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli
items.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade warmly welcomed the Oyo State APC governorship candidate to Ibarapa land and reaffirmed the region’s readiness to support the vision of progress.
items.body: On behalf of the good people of Eruwa, Lanlate, and the entire Ibarapa East Constituency, Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade warmly welcomes our esteemed Governorship Candidate, Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli, to Ibarapa land! Your vision for a prosperous Oyo State and your commitment to grassroots development continue to inspire us. Ibarapa land stands united and ready to walk this journey of progress with you. #IbarapaWelcomesAlli #OyoAhead #OyoState2027 #HonBabatundeOgunlade #ProgressForOyo
items.imageAlt: Welcome banner for Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli in Ibarapa land
items.source: Office of Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade

items.title: Hon. Babs Expresses Gratitude to BSO Support Group for Campaign Logistics Boost
items.summary: The campaign organization expressed appreciation to the BSO Support Group for donating 50 street pole banners and campaign ludo games for grassroots mobilization.
items.body: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade and the BABS 2027 Campaign Organization extend heartfelt gratitude to the BSO Support Group, led by Mr. Faremi Sunday (AKA Oluwalogbon), for their donation of 50 street pole banners and Campaign Ludo Games towards campaign grassroots mobilization efforts. This generous support demonstrates a shared commitment to community development, youth engagement, and progressive representation across Eruwa and Lanlate.
items.imageAlt: BSO Support Group donation of campaign banners and ludo games
